exposure: Weekly retrospective review conference to discuss all cesarean deliveries
weekly review of all criteria for cesarean delivery
cohort: 5,541 women with term singleton vertex gestations
finding: Implementation of a weekly review conference was associated with a reduction in both overall cesarean delivery prevalence and labored indications at the institution.
mod_finding: Implementation of a weekly review conference was associated with a reduction in both overall cesarean delivery prevalence and labored indications at the study institution.
